title: Recovery codes written to user storage lose one-time-use, hashing, and metadata
description: createRecoveryCodesCredential flattens RecoveryAuthnCodesCredentialModel into a bare UserCredentialModel, dropping hashing, per-code ordinal, remaining-count, and metadata. Storage boundary discards the model; provider update logic never runs, so used codes are never consumed and any leaked code becomes a permanent second-factor bypass.

title: Test helpers copied verbatim from RecoveryAuthnCodesAuthenticatorTest, typo and dead config included
description: configureBrowserFlowWithRecoveryAuthnCodes and enterRecoveryCodes are duplicated from shared test, carrying over a 'delayed-suthenticator-config' typo and unused delayed-authenticator execution (delay=0). Dead code dependency causes unrelated failures if provider changes; copies drift independently.
